biology: The specimens were collected from the lacquer tree Rhus verniciflus.
soldier: Head yellowish brown and rather deep, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.60–0.64, the sides nearly parallel and slightly broadened in the middle and posterior parts, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal region is slightly raised, the interfrontal area shallowly concave. The labrum is broadly lingulate, the apex broadly rounded, the apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all rather long. The mandibles are rather straight, their apices slender and slightly curved; the mandibular length 0.57–0.61 times the head capsule length and 0.91–0.97 times the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum falls roughly at the anterior one-fifth, its anterolateral margin nearly trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the middle slightly concave; the waist region slender and narrow with the sides nearly in a broad arc, the waist constriction index 0.26–0.27. The pronotum is kidney-shaped, about 1.5–1.6 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins both appearing as two broad intersecting arcs, the median notch of the anterior deeper than that of the posterior, with about thirty hairs in the middle region.
